scenarios.name: null
scenarios.role: no decay effect at either writes; gates do not self-normalise

scenarios.name: small_below_line
scenarios.role: true effects one third of the line

scenarios.name: line_both
scenarios.role: true decay effect exactly at the line (wave-1 defect: must not read KILL)

scenarios.name: line_tnie_only
scenarios.role: oracle parity benefit at the line, no pure decay cost

scenarios.name: line_pnie_only
scenarios.role: pure decay at the line, fully absorbed at the re-segmented writes

scenarios.name: material_strong
scenarios.role: per-token clock dominant, mild negative interaction

scenarios.name: masked
scenarios.role: pure decay material, absorbed by the re-segmented writes

scenarios.name: masked_partial
scenarios.role: S1-like: pure decay large, oracle benefit small
